quarterly_data.signal: CEO Sanjiv Patel: lead asset zovegalisib, a PI3K-alpha mutant-selective inhibitor, is being developed in three indications. In second-line HR+/HER2- breast cancer, data at the pivotal 400 milligram BID dose showed 11 months of PFS versus 'the 5 and a half months of capivasertib'; a 1-to-1 randomized pivotal trial of fulvestrant plus zovegalisib versus fulvestrant plus capivasertib opened in mid-2025 (President of R&D Don Bergstrom), with precedent trials taking 30 to 36 months to fully enroll, and an update on expected last patient in comes at year end. Chief Corporate Development Officer Peter Rahmer put the class at 'about a USD 1 billion run rate and still growing' and said phase I/II data now span 120 patients.
quarterly_data.figure: PFS 11 months at 400 milligram BID vs 5 and a half months for capivasertib; pivotal trial opened mid-2025; 30 to 36 months precedent enrollment; 120 patients

quarterly_data.signal: First-line breast cancer: Relay chose a triplet of endocrine therapy plus Pfizer's selective CDK4 inhibitor atirmociclib plus zovegalisib for tolerability. President of R&D Don Bergstrom said it is designing a randomized trial in the larger endocrine-sensitive population (aromatase inhibitor plus atirmociclib plus zovegalisib versus aromatase inhibitor plus an investigator's-choice CDK4/6), and that co-administration raises zovegalisib absorption so triplet doses of 100 milligram BID and 150 milligram BID match the exposure of 400 milligrams BID in the doublet. With ReDiscover-2 in second line, management expects labels that could 'capture the vast majority' of metastatic PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer.
quarterly_data.figure: triplet doses 100 milligram BID and 150 milligram BID vs 400 milligrams BID doublet

quarterly_data.signal: Vascular anomalies (Chief Corporate Development Officer Peter Rahmer): total addressable market of $6 billion-$8 billion, about 170,000 U.S. patients with PIK3CA mutations and about 25,000 addressable patients across PROS, lymphatic and venous malformations; at Vijoice pricing of $36,000 a month, every 2,500-3,000 patients would be $1 billion of sales. Initial ReInspire data across 20 patients showed a 60% volumetric response rate versus 20%-30% for alpelisib; 32 patients were enrolled in the dose-randomized portion, and expansion cohorts opened at 300 milligrams BID and 400 milligrams once daily (enrollment prioritized). Relay will show more data and a regulatory update before year end, proposing accelerated approval by pooling PROS and lymphatic malformation patients within ReInspire.
quarterly_data.figure: TAM $6 billion-$8 billion; about 170,000 U.S. patients; about 25,000 addressable; 60% volumetric response rate across 20 patients; 32 patients dose-randomized

quarterly_data.signal: President of R&D Don Bergstrom said Relay 'were able to use our platform to discover a novel pocket in NRAS' and exploit it to make an NRAS-selective inhibitor, RLY-8161, active as a single agent in preclinical melanoma, lung and colorectal models with almost no toxicity in non-clinical toxicology; it entered the clinic earlier this year. CEO Sanjiv Patel said the $911 million cash balance will fund mainly the three registrational trials (first-line, second-line and vascular anomalies), that the research footprint has been significantly reduced since 2021-2022, and that in this cash window Relay can deliver top-line registrational data for the second-line and vascular anomalies trials and be significantly through the frontline trial.
